title: Potential change: minimum site area reduced up to 10% where the existing dwelling is retained
text: Potential change: New provision to allow minimum site area to be reduced up to 10 per cent where the existing dwelling is retained. Refer to Information Sheet 5: Lot size and density.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

verified.note: Pink potential-change text only; checked verbatim. Nothing operative.

notes: Content twin of Chapter 2 M4.1.5, renumbered M4.1.6 in Chapter 3 (p53). Flagged potential change only (pink); no operative text, code range or conditions.
